name: Mask Reveal
description: A second version of the content, a water-blue layer seen through a round hole that follows the pointer and opens wide over the text.

props.name: children
props.description: The base content, centred. The hole opens to revealSize while the pointer is over any element inside it.

props.name: reveal
props.description: The content of the layer under the ice, centred in the same box. Lay it out like the base so the two line up.

props.name: size
props.description: Diameter of the hole in pixels while the pointer is over empty space.

props.name: revealSize
props.description: Diameter of the hole in pixels while the pointer is over the content.

props.name: feather
props.description: Width of the soft edge of the hole, in pixels.

props.name: className
props.description: Classes for the root, a focusable group. Give it a size; a radius is passed on to the revealed layer. Keyboard focus opens the whole layer. Other div props are passed through, including aria-label.
